evidence: "Find smallest w > v connected to both u and v"; "We need to find a triangle"; "common = mask_a &"
affordance_in_statement: A deadlock is formed by choosing exactly three reports from the log that satisfy a specific frequency condition: if you tally how many times each worker ID appears across your chosen three reports, exactly three workers will have a tally of exactly 2, and all other workers will have a tally of 0.
removal_suggestion: No wording-only removal is possible without changing the task: the stated endpoint-frequency condition is exactly equivalent to selecting the three edges of a triangle. Any re-presentation would need to obscure this equivalence through a genuinely different task or input encoding.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Treats the three reports as the three edges of a triangle and searches for a common neighbor.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Exactly three reports give exactly three workers frequency 2, which means every pair among those workers must be a report.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Explicitly reduces the condition to finding a lexicographically smallest triangle.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The frequency condition on three two-worker reports is equivalent to edges (a,b), (b,c), and (c,a) all existing.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Builds normalized undirected edges and adjacency data suitable for triangle detection.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The reports are unordered worker pairs, so the required three reports form an undirected triangle.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses adjacency bitsets and intersects neighbors to detect triangles.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The three reports must connect each pair of the three workers, enabling neighbor-set intersection.

common_affordance: The endpoint-frequency definition of a deadlock is exactly the existence of a triangle in the undirected graph whose vertices are workers and whose edges are reports.
recommended_edit: There is no single wording edit that can defeat all survivors while preserving the problem: the triangle equivalence is the intrinsic mathematical structure of the task. To defeat these solutions, the task would need to change materially, such as replacing the three-report frequency condition with a non-equivalent certificate condition or changing the report representation so that adjacency is not directly available.
